plugins.name: claude-code-studios
plugins.description: Full software studio for Claude Code: 45 specialist agents across game AND app/web/service development, 90 workflow skills, and production hooks covering pre-production through live-ops. v0.6.6 asks the question every other gate assumed: `scripts/verify_install.py` reads the host's install registry and answers whether this plugin is actually wired in — on 2026-09-19 a session had the cache present at 0.6.5, `enabledPlugins` true and `verify_trajectory.py` exiting 0 while loading zero hooks, agents and skills, because the registry had lost its entry and every existing gate only ever read the copy on disk (16 tests). It also unbroke the suite on Windows: 90 hook tests were running against System32's WSL launcher instead of Git Bash, so `tests/posix_bash.py` now probes a candidate before trusting its name — the hooks were fine and had never run. (v0.6.5 gave the runtime-split world an actual reader; v0.6.4 made the deterministic-gate contract survive the console it runs in.)
